blocks.html:
Relief valves shall be set to discharge at not more than 1 1/2 times the maximum working pressure of the system. The discharge from relief valves shall be returned to the storage tank or to the supply line. Shut-off valves are not permitted in the line of relief.
Section MC 1308: Testing
